profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Solutions Architecture | Enterprise Integration | Applied AI | Cloud & Resilient Systems
profile.summary:
I design connected systems that turn complexity into business capability.

With more than two decades of experience in software engineering, architecture, and enterprise integration, I currently serve as a Lead Software Engineer at SERVPRO, where I help design and deliver scalable, secure, and business-aligned software solutions. My work focuses on solutions architecture, cloud-native platforms, enterprise integration, iPaaS, event-driven design, and modern application delivery.

I enjoy working at the intersection of business needs and technical execution: translating complex requirements into practical architecture, connecting systems and data across platforms, and helping teams deliver solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with organizational goals. I am AWS Certified and have experience designing solutions that balance scalability, efficiency, resiliency, and cost-effectiveness.

In addition to my role at SERVPRO, I serve as an Adjunct Professor of Computer Science at Northeast State Community College, where I teach programming fundamentals, algorithmic thinking, and practical software development concepts. Teaching strengthens one of the most important parts of architecture: the ability to explain complex ideas clearly, mentor others, and connect technical concepts to real-world outcomes.

My professional focus is on solutions architecture, enterprise integration, cloud architecture, resilient systems, and applied AI. I am especially interested in opportunities where architecture, integration strategy, modern platforms, and AI-enabled business capabilities come together.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a talented team of developers at SERVPRO to drive the development and delivery of high-quality software solutions.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable, efficient, and innovative solutions.
• Ensured adherence to coding standards, defined system architecture, and championed new technologies for technical excellence.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
I drive architecture design and cloud-native development efforts, integrating customer interfaces with third-party services for seamless data transactions and improved user experiences. I define the technical vision for software systems, considering system requirements, performance, and business needs. I architect solutions that comply with relevant regulatory standards and security protocols to protect data and systems.

*	Specialized in designing and implementing cost-efficient AWS solutions, effectively utilizing pricing models and optimization tools to minimize operational expenses.
*	Led AWS Cloud Migration, enhancing scalability and reliability.
*	Developed a conversion automation tool that reduced manual labor by over 520 hours, achieving a 69% cost reduction.
*	Orchestrate integration of SharePoint API with AWS cloud-native systems, improving document management capabilities.
*	Led and mentored a team of seven nearshore developers, ensuring project success and effective team communication.
*	Conducted ongoing technological exploration to refine design and implementation practices, ensuring alignment with business requirements.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description:
Adjunct Professor of Computer Science at Northeast State Community College, committed to delivering clear, rigorous instruction in foundational computing. I focus on strengthening students’ understanding of algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, and core programming principles while fostering the confidence needed to progress in the discipline.

Drawing on professional experience in software architecture and ongoing doctoral research, I integrate real-world context with academic fundamentals to help students appreciate both the theory and practice of computer science. I emphasize structured learning, practical application, and a supportive environment that encourages growth and persistence.

My goal is to equip students with the analytical mindset and technical foundation essential for success in advanced coursework, industry roles, and continued academic study.

positions.title: Senior Web Applications Developer (Team Lead)
positions.description:
I led the development team in designing and architecting robust web applications aligned with strategic business objectives. I also designed scalable and secure Azure-based architecture, optimizing the application’s performance, availability, and cost-efficiency. I actively liaised with cross-functional teams, including developers and stakeholders, to ensure the Azure architecture aligned with business objectives and technical requirements.

*	Achieved a 5x increase in page responsiveness through diligent application migration to Aurelia and Web API.
*	Enabled scalable application infrastructure by contributing to Azure Cloud integration and architectural designs.
*	Streamlined development processes and improved code reusability by designing a versatile plugin framework.
*	Enhanced user experience and aligned technology solutions with corporate goals by designing and maintaining high-performance web applications.
*	Fostered team collaboration and ensured project delivery within deadlines, driving high-quality software solutions that met organizational aims.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architectural Design · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET · Web Services · Entity Framework · Engineering Design · JavaScript · Aurelia · ASP.NET MVC · Team Leadership · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
I architected and engineered business applications focusing on complex systems such as pricing, margin, and fee management, ensuring robust and efficient operations. I also implemented comprehensive QA testing, enforced code quality through reviews, and produced meticulous documentation for clear stakeholder communication.

*	Designed a cloud-based document management service using AWS S3 and DynamoDB, streamlining workflow processes.
*	Developed SOA-based architecture and core services, contributing to enterprise scalability and modernization.
*	Created multiple microservice APIs, facilitating efficient access to enterprise services by other development teams.
